newsitem.title: USA: Dow slips near session lows, NYSE re-sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow slips near session lows, NYSE re-sets curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks gyrated lower in late afternoon Wednesday, triggering NYSE index-arbitrage trading curbs for the second time today.
The Dow industrials fell 51 points to 7262, triggering program trading curbs at 1544 EDT/1944 GMT.
The most recent losses proved short-lived, however, and the Dow quickly bounced off its afternoon lows to climb to 7272, down 39 points just moments before the closing bell.
